parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance.
> You can call [DescribeInstanceIds](~~157459~~) to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description:
The mode of AI-based intelligent protection for non-website services. Valid values:
- **normal**: Normal.
- **loose**: Loose.
- **strict**: Strict.

parameters.name: Switch
parameters.description:
The status of AI-based intelligent protection for non-website services. Valid values:
- **on**: enabled
- **off**: disabled
